research_question: Can topology alone classify universal reconvergence, partial reconvergence, and obstruction across the continuation graphs generated from the bounded Notebook 12 configuration domain?
hypothesis: Within the bounded Notebook 12 domain, graph-topological invariants mediate the sequence local mechanisms -> continuation graph topology -> reconvergence geometry -> J. Version 2 tests the same hypothesis with ordered, chunked, checkpointed execution to avoid Colab state loss.

independent_variables.name: continuation_graph_topology
independent_variables.definition: Topology-only representation of each regenerated Notebook 12 continuation graph after removing mechanism labels from the classifier feature set.
independent_variables.allowed_values_or_range: One invariant vector per Notebook 12 factorial configuration.

independent_variables.name: execution_chunk
independent_variables.definition: Contiguous row chunk from the Notebook 12 factorial table.
independent_variables.allowed_values_or_range: Non-overlapping chunks covering all available rows.

controls.name: cell_order_control
controls.purpose: Prevent missing-name errors from partial or out-of-order execution.
controls.implementation: All imports, paths, graph reconstruction, and invariant functions are defined in one bootstrap cell.

controls.name: checkpoint_resume_control
controls.purpose: Prevent Colab crashes from destroying completed work.
controls.implementation: Each chunk writes a persistent checkpoint file and reruns skip completed chunk files.

controls.name: notebook_12_column_mapping_control
controls.implementation: SystemConfig is reconstructed only from Notebook 12 columns: state_modulus, max_depth, branch_width, initial_value, initial_suffix, schedule_seed, and mechanism booleans.

controls.name: mechanism_label_exclusion
controls.purpose: Prevent mechanism identity from leaking into topology-only classifier features.
controls.implementation: Classifier feature selection excludes mask_bits, mechanism booleans, active_mechanism_count, config_id, geometry, and J.

random_seed.seed_scope: train/test splits, randomized baselines, and deterministic chunk metadata
random_seed.derivation_policy: Fixed before execution; derived seeds must be deterministic functions of 130013 and recorded in output manifests.

parameter_space.name: chunk_size
parameter_space.values_or_range: Default 250; may be lowered for Colab RAM/runtime stability before execution starts.

termination_conditions: Every available Notebook 12 row is processed or has a recoverable skip reason.
Chunk checkpoints are written under the governed output directory.
Aggregated invariant table, skip table, classifier report, counterexample catalog, and manifest are written.
No post-hoc invariant family is added without a superseding specification.

expected_outputs.name: chunk_checkpoints
expected_outputs.interpretation_role: Recoverable partial progress for Colab runtime stability.

expected_outputs.name: topological_invariant_table
expected_outputs.interpretation_role: Primary topology-only invariant table joined to Notebook 12 geometry/J labels.

expected_outputs.name: classification_report
expected_outputs.interpretation_role: Reports whether topology-only features classify geometry above controls inside the bounded domain.

expected_outputs.name: output_manifest
expected_outputs.interpretation_role: Binds inputs, outputs, hashes, seed, chunking, and claim ceiling.

decision_rules: SUCCESS_C2_CANDIDATE: topology-only invariant families classify geometry above baseline and graph-size controls with recoverable outputs.
PARTIAL_C2_CANDIDATE: topology separates obstruction from non-obstruction or predicts J strata but fails full three-class classification.
FAILURE_OR_LIMITATION_C2_CANDIDATE: topology-equivalent signatures produce different geometry/J labels or performance collapses under controls.
INCONCLUSIVE: data loading, graph regeneration, or dependency constraints prevent complete evaluation.
allowed_interpretations: Bounded Notebook 12 domain observation about topology-only classification.
blocked_interpretations: Claim that Notebook 13 succeeded before execution.
Claim that topology universally governs reconvergence outside Notebook 12.
Claim promotion above C2 without approved-tool replication and independent measurements.

immutability.supersession_policy: Supersedes NB13_TOPOLOGICAL_INVARIANTS_CONTINUATION_GEOMETRY_001 for Colab execution robustness; do not edit after execution starts.
